sentences.text: In short: CUTIE AS is an established company in "engroshandel med klær og skotøy" based in Asker, loss-making in 2025.

CUTIE AS is registered in the industry "Engroshandel med klær og skotøy"; its registered activity is "Salg og wholesale av strømpebukser, tights, leggings, shapewear, hold in, natt-tøy, bukser, undertøy, badetøy sokker.".
CUTIE AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2018-12-15, registered in Asker.
It an operating loss of NOK 2,333 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show negative equity of -NOK 3,752 (liabilities exceed assets).
The annual result was a loss in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: -NOK 71,897, 2024: -NOK 20,906, 2025: -NOK 2,333).
CUTIE AS is led by board chair Jeanette Rolfsen Heyerdahl.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-07-09 (within the past year).
